# NeuromorphicHardwareDeployment

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The process of mapping and executing continual learning algorithms on spiking neural network hardware, respecting constraints like synaptic plasticity and energy budgets. Bridges algorithmic continual learning with physical neuromorphic substrates, essential for practical iNEST implementations in resource-constrained network nodes.
